variants.headline: Looking back: home world changes the charter
variants.sub: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The home world had changed the colony's charter.

A charter amendment warrants attention, but it is not a sufficiently detailed basis for changing an operating assumption. Owners and managers should distinguish the known alteration of the framework from particular legal effects. Commercial judgment requires the relevant provision, rather than a general impression that the rules have changed.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

This paper examines {target} through the fact of the amendment, without announcing a specific legal effect not contained in the report. The exercise of authority and its justification merit separate scrutiny.
